answer: Each identity must show three paid-task receipts that chain across epochs: the first task unlocks the second, the second unlocks the third, so a new identity needs three epochs of work. Every receipt carries a pigment tag unique to its counterparty pair, exposing a farm that reuses one partner. A walnut-hard bond of 50 POA backs the chain, slashed if a receipt fails audit. Bonds are charged per funder: the Nth identity from one wallet posts 50 x N^2 POA, so one fake costs 170 POA while ten cost 20,450. No one can forge this chain without buying three paid interactions per fake identity.
